_meta.scope: Scholarship application rejections on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) style workflow

reasons.title: Your institute has not verified the application
reasons.explanation: Your application must be checked by your college or school nodal officer before it moves ahead. It is stuck at that step.
fix_steps: Log in to the portal and note the exact status and remark.
Visit your college scholarship or nodal officer with your application ID and original documents.
Ask them to verify the application on the portal and note the date you asked.
If nothing moves after about two weeks, put your request in writing and keep a copy.
reasons.route: Contact your institute nodal officer first. Escalate in writing, then use the portal grievance option.
reasons.letter_subject: Request to verify my scholarship application
reasons.letter_template:
To,
The Nodal Officer,
[Institute name]

Subject: Request to verify scholarship application [Application ID]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, [Your name], a student of [Course, Year], applied for [Scholarship name] (Application ID: [Application ID]). The portal shows that my application is pending verification at the institute level. I request you to verify it at the earliest so that it can move to the next stage before the deadline.

I have attached my documents for reference.

Thank you.
[Your name]
[Phone number]
[Date]

reasons.title: Income certificate problem
reasons.explanation: The income certificate you uploaded was not accepted. Common causes are an expired certificate, one from the wrong issuing authority, an unreadable scan, or an income value that does not match what you entered.
fix_steps: Read the officer remark to see which of these applies.
Check the issue date and the issuing authority on your certificate against the scheme guidelines.
If needed, get a fresh certificate from the correct authority.
Make sure the income on the certificate matches what you entered in the form.
Upload a clear, full-page scan in the allowed format and size, then resubmit if the status is Defective.
reasons.route: If Defective: correct and resubmit within the allowed window. If Rejected: use the grievance route or apply next cycle.
reasons.contact: Issuing authority for the certificate, then the nodal officer
reasons.letter_subject: Request for review of income certificate remark
reasons.letter_template:
To,
The Nodal Officer,
[Institute / State nodal office]

Subject: Review of income certificate remark, Application ID [Application ID]

Respected Sir/Madam,

My application for [Scholarship name] (Application ID: [Application ID]) was marked with a remark about my income certificate. I have attached a [new / corrected] certificate issued by [issuing authority] on [date]. I request you to review it and allow my application to proceed.

Thank you.
[Your name]
[Phone number]
[Date]

reasons.title: Name or date of birth does not match across documents
reasons.explanation: Your name, date of birth, or category is written differently in two documents (for example Aadhaar, marksheet, bank passbook). The verifier cannot confirm they belong to the same person.
fix_steps: Put your Aadhaar, marksheet, bank passbook and certificates side by side.
Find which document differs, even by one letter or initial.
Correct the wrong document through its issuing authority, or ask your institute whether an affidavit or bonafide letter is accepted.
Update the portal entry to match the corrected document and resubmit if the status is Defective.
reasons.route: Fix the source document first. Then correct and resubmit if Defective, or use grievance and apply next cycle if Rejected.
reasons.contact: Issuing authority of the mismatched document, then the nodal officer
reasons.letter_template:
To,
The Nodal Officer,
[Institute / State nodal office]

Subject: Details mismatch, Application ID [Application ID]

Respected Sir/Madam,

My application for [Scholarship name] was marked for a mismatch in [name / date of birth]. The correct detail is [correct detail] as shown in [document]. I have attached supporting documents and request you to update or accept the correction so that my application can proceed.

Thank you.
[Your name]
[Phone number]
[Date]

reasons.title: Bank account or Aadhaar seeding problem
reasons.explanation: The scholarship money cannot be sent to your bank account. Usually the account is not linked to Aadhaar for payments, the name differs, or the account details are wrong.
fix_steps: Check that the account number and IFSC code in your form are correct.
Ask your bank whether the account is linked to Aadhaar for receiving government payments.
Confirm the name on the account matches your Aadhaar and the portal.
Update your bank details on the portal if it allows, or ask your nodal officer how to correct them.
reasons.route: Fix with your bank first, then update details through the portal or nodal officer.
reasons.contact: Your bank branch, then the nodal officer
reasons.letter_subject: Request to update bank details for scholarship
reasons.letter_template:
To,
The Nodal Officer,
[Institute / State nodal office]

reasons.title: Wrong, unclear or incomplete document uploaded
reasons.explanation: A document you uploaded is not the one required, is cut off or blurry, or is not in the required format. A common example is uploading a computation sheet where an acceptance or acknowledgement is required.
fix_steps: Open the officer remark to see which document is meant.
Check the scheme guidelines for the exact document and format it asks for.
Re-scan the full page in good light, in the right file type and size.
Upload the correct document and resubmit if the status is Defective.
reasons.route: If Defective: replace the document and resubmit within the window. If Rejected: grievance or next cycle.

reasons.title: Eligibility condition not met
reasons.explanation: The reviewer found that you do not meet one of the scheme conditions, such as the income limit, minimum marks, course, or category. A Rejected application usually cannot be edited.
fix_steps: Read the remark and the scheme guidelines side by side to find the exact condition.
Check whether you entered something wrongly. If so, raise a grievance with proof.
If the condition truly does not apply to you, look for other schemes you do qualify for.
Note the next application window.
reasons.route: Grievance if you believe it is wrong. Otherwise apply for another scheme or in the next cycle.

reasons.title: State level officer found incorrect details
reasons.explanation: After your institute approved it, the state level officer found a detail that did not check out, such as domicile, category or course information.
fix_steps: Read which detail the state officer named.
Gather the proof document for that detail, such as domicile or category certificate.
If the status is Defective, correct the detail and resubmit.
If Rejected, raise a grievance with the proof attached.
reasons.route: Correct and resubmit if Defective. Grievance with proof if Rejected.
reasons.contact: State nodal officer through the portal
reasons.letter_subject: Request to review state level remark

reasons.title: Application marked as fake
reasons.explanation: The reviewer believes the application contains false or duplicate information. This is serious and is usually not editable.
fix_steps: Read the officer remark carefully to see what was flagged.
If you believe it is an error, gather your original documents.
Raise a grievance with the portal and meet your nodal officer in person.
Ask for the reason and the records on file in writing, and keep copies of everything.
reasons.route: Grievance and nodal officer. If the reason is unclear, consider a request under the Right to Information Act.
reasons.contact: Nodal officer, portal grievance, then RTI if needed
